clue.text: Record discharge by source of honey

parts.note: an arc is an electrical discharge across a gap
a beehive is where honey comes from

explanation.surface: A file note about someone's release, filed alongside the beekeeper's details.
explanation.walkthrough: 'by' just places one piece beside the other.
explanation.definitionFit: A stored collection of documents is a record kept for history.

clue.text: Lack of interest current that is holding up detectives

parts.note: AC is alternating current
CID is the Criminal Investigation Department, the British police detectives
i.e. abbreviates id est, 'that is'

explanation.surface: Apathy in today's world means the police are being held back.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down entry 'that is holding up detectives' puts IE below CID.
explanation.definitionFit: Accidie is spiritual sloth or apathy, a listless indifference.

clue.text: Not keen when given a vegetarian item, but unfazed

parts.note: cool can mean unenthusiastic
as can mean while or when
a cucumber is a salad vegetable

explanation.surface: Someone lukewarm about a vegetarian dish nonetheless stays calm.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes someone perfectly calm and composed.

clue.text: stinks? Certainly not

parts.note: the question and its denial describe something that gives off no smell at all

explanation.definitionFit: Something odourless has no scent, so it certainly doesn't reek.

clue.text: Rub out the Queen as early leader

parts.note: ER is Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its opening letter, here of 'early'

explanation.surface: Deleting the monarch from history as an early ruler.
explanation.definitionFit: To delete is to wipe away completely.

clue.text: Isle is wrongly shown beside Austria in European region

indicators.note: the words are displayed in the wrong order, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: A is the international vehicle code for Austria

explanation.surface: A map mislabels an island next to Austria in central Europe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wrongly shown' rearranges ISLEIS to SILESI; 'beside' joins A.
explanation.definitionFit: Historic area of central Europe now mostly in Poland.

clue.text: Dessert before vegetables

parts.note: reads as a back-to-front meal order, but describes a garden flower named as a pudding word followed by a pod-vegetable word

explanation.walkthrough: A sweet is a British dessert and peas are vegetables, so the flower's name reads as one before the other.
explanation.definitionFit: Fragrant climbing garden flowers of the pea family.

clue.text: Awfully cruel getting filthy sort of money?

indicators.note: done awfully means done badly, so the letters of the next word are jumbled

explanation.surface: A cruel act is rewarded with dirty cash.
explanation.definitionFit: The stock phrase 'filthy lucre' means money gained dishonourably.

clue.text: What led wise men to a sort of growth?

explanation.surface: A question about the Magi's guide and a medical lump.
explanation.definitionFit: The Magi followed a guiding light at the Nativity; it is also the name of a bulb plant with white starry blooms.

clue.text: A looser sort of spray coming from this?

definitions.text: A looser sort of spray coming from this?

indicators.note: a sort of something is a variant of it, so the letters are put in another order

explanation.surface: A slacker kind of spray emerges from a can.
explanation.definitionFit: A pressurised can releases its contents as a fine mist.

clue.text: Create alcoholic sort of confection long in extent but short in duration

definitions.text: confection long in extent but short in duration

indicators.note: a sort of something is a variant of it, so these words' letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Inventing a boozy pudding that is long but soon gone.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition plays on a finger-shaped pastry that is eaten in moments.
explanation.definitionFit: A long choux pastry with cream and a cocoa topping that doesn't last long once served.

clue.text: Doctor joins a company as giver of hard laws in Greece

definitions.text: giver of hard laws in Greece

explanation.surface: A medic joins a firm as a strict Greek lawmaker.
explanation.definitionFit: The Athenian lawgiver whose harsh code gave us 'draconian'.

clue.text: Enter changes with common sense between us

indicators.note: the word before changes its form, so its letters are rearranged

parts.note: nous is practical intelligence

explanation.surface: A newcomer adapts using good judgement, in confidence.
explanation.definitionFit: French phrase meaning privately, in confidence between two people.

clue.text: Complicated energy lab talk

parts.note: E is the symbol for energy
to orate is to give a speech

explanation.surface: A scientific lecture about energy proves too intricate.
explanation.definitionFit: Elaborate means detailed and intricate, the same as convoluted.

clue.text: Governor turned up playing polo, having imported a South American horse

indicators.note: in a down entry turned up means read from the bottom, so the governor's word goes backwards

parts.note: the governor is slang for father, PA

indicators.note: the anagrammed word takes in the next piece, which sits inside it
playing suggests the letters are moving about, so they are rearranged

parts.note: SA abbreviates South America(n)

explanation.surface: An upside-down governor at a polo match imports a Latin American mount.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned up' gives AP; 'playing' makes PLOO from POLO, and 'having imported' puts A in it for PALOO.
explanation.definitionFit: A spotted breed of riding horse from North America.

clue.text: Woman married third man?

parts.note: after Adam and Cain, Abel was the third man in Genesis

explanation.surface: A woman marries the third man in her life.
explanation.definitionFit: A girl's given name, so a female.

clue.text: David, say, about to have Uriah butchered in eastern region

parts.note: David is an example of a man's name
c. (circa) means about

indicators.note: butchered means hacked to pieces, so the name's letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: King David arranges for Uriah to be killed, from the Bible.
explanation.walkthrough: In the Bible David had Uriah killed; here 'butchered' turns URIAH into HURIA.
explanation.definitionFit: A historical area of north-east China.

clue.text: This food is suitable for larvae

definitions.text: This food is suitable for larvae

parts.words: This food is suitable for larvae
parts.note: grub is slang for food, and the same word in the plural names insect larvae

explanation.definitionFit: Slang for meals, and also the name of beetle larvae.

clue.text: Lightweight cat, we hear, or a sea creature

parts.note: a gram is a tiny unit of weight

indicators.note: says the following word as it sounds when spoken

parts.note: puss is a familiar word for a cat

explanation.surface: A tiny kitten, or something fishy in the ocean.
explanation.definitionFit: Another name for Risso's dolphin or the killer whale.

clue.text: Following delivery of letters to South African province?

parts.note: the post is letters delivered by mail
Natal is a former province of South Africa

explanation.surface: Mail sent off to a province in South Africa.
explanation.walkthrough: 'delivery' leans toward the post too, but belongs to the definition as childbirth.
explanation.definitionFit: Describes the period after childbirth.

clue.text: Small floating platform where you see pal idly lounging

indicators.note: lounging suggests lying about loosely, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A frog's view of a friend relaxing on a leaf in a pond.
explanation.definitionFit: The broad floating leaf of a water plant.

clue.text: Friendly as a pawnbroker?

parts.note: a pawnbroker is called 'uncle' in British slang, so this asks for an uncle-like kindness

explanation.walkthrough: In British slang a pawnbroker is 'uncle', so behaving like one means being kind as an uncle is.
explanation.definitionFit: Kind and genial in the manner of a relative such as a father's brother.

clue.text: What may mark high point of in-car design?

indicators.note: a design is a fresh arrangement, so the letters are reworked

explanation.surface: A dashboard ornament marking the top spec of a car interior.
explanation.definitionFit: A pile of stones set up on a summit as a marker.

clue.text: Move fast, getting in charge of ancient characters

parts.note: to run is to move quickly

explanation.surface: Hurrying to take control of some old figures.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective describing the old Germanic alphabet's letters.

clue.text: One in meeting room is ritually slaughtered

indicators.note: in puts the single letter inside the room's word

parts.note: a hall is a room for gatherings
a means one

explanation.surface: Someone at a gathering is killed in a ceremony.
explanation.definitionFit: Describes meat prepared according to Islamic law.

clue.text: In superb clip how to represent the result of nationalisation

indicators.note: the letters are made to stand for something else in a new order

explanation.surface: A great video clip explaining what state takeover produces.
explanation.definitionFit: When industries are nationalised, the state takes them over for the people.

clue.text: In cosy ring arrange mock orange

indicators.note: in signals the letters sit within the words that follow

explanation.surface: Arranging a shrub in a snug circle in a garden.
explanation.walkthrough: 'arrange' looks like an anagram signal but just supplies letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Syringa is a shrub, also called philadelphus, with fragrant white flowers.

clue.text: Won over Switzerland, prepared to fight

parts.note: CH is the international code for Switzerland
armed means carrying weapons

explanation.surface: Neutral Switzerland conquered by an army ready for battle.
explanation.definitionFit: Charmed means delighted or won over.
